PM Modi Claims Urban-Rural Gap Narrowed in 12 Years

Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated on Friday that the gap between urban and rural India has narrowed significantly over the past 12 years. He also claimed that infrastructure in villages has improved significantly during the same period.
